question_stem:
A small coil of wire is situated in a non-uniform magnetic field, as shown in Fig. 10.1.

{{figure:figure_10_1}}

Fig. 10.1

The coil consists of 40 turns of wire and moves with a constant speed in a straight line. The coil has displacement $x$ from a fixed point P.

The variation with $x$ of the magnetic flux $\Phi$ in the coil is shown in Fig. 10.2.

{{figure:figure_10_2}}

Fig. 10.2

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.part_stem: The coil is moved at constant speed between point P and the point where $x = 3.0\text{ cm}$.
parts.text: Calculate the change in magnetic flux linkage of the coil.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: The e.m.f. induced in the coil is $5.0 \times 10^{-4}\text{V}$. Determine the speed of the coil.
